CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

November 26, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: October 22, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the October 22, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

ITEM 2:  MINUTES: November 12, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the November 12, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  consent item #2 for discussion.
  • The second was by Board member Daninger.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 6:  904 South Olive Avenue, DRB-2024-0013

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 3 ft. high front yard fence, swing gate,
  and sliding gate on an existing residential lot.
  •  Applicant: Raymond Ming He
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Apply a paint finish on the proposed fence / gate that matches the decorative
  metal post found on the existing front entry porch.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions:
  1. Apply a paint finish on the proposed fence / gate that matches the decorative
  metal post found on the existing front entry porch.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve that includes the fence post and guide heights.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  3
 ITEM 7:  208 North Granada Avenue, DRB-2024-00058

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 400 SF addition and 14 window
  replacements on an existing 1-story single-family house.
  •  Applicant: Sarina Troung
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to continue the application with the
  following considerations:
  1. The applicant should update the scope of work, color/material board and
  include proposed re-roofing information.
  2. The applicant should include color building elevations.
  3. The applicant should provide additional photos of the existing conditions from
  all sides of the building.
  4. The applicant should provide a note that identifies existing rafter tails to be
  repaired or refurbished.
  5. The applicant should revise the door and window schedule information to be
  accurate and consistent with the floor plans.
  6. The applicant should revise the door and window sills to be a wood material /
  finish.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 8:  230 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00104

  •  Request: This is an application for a new solid panel roof screens, storefront
  changes, and new pedestrian ramp and handrails on an existing 2-story
  commercial building.
  •  Applicant: Will Vallecios & Sarah Del Rosario
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  4
 ITEM 9:  1815 South Meridian Avenue, DRB-2024-00116

  •  Request: This is an application for a 2,149 SF 1- and 2-story addition to an existing
  1,465 SF 1-story single-family house with a 440 SF expansion of the existing 2-car
  garage at street level.
  •  Applicant: Chabeli Hernandez
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Revise the parapet / balcony design on the southeast side, such as replacing
  the parapet elevation with a sloped roof with Spanish tiles and exposed wood
  rafters, to break-up large areas of blank wall along the front elevation. This will
  overall improve the building mass and emphasize the front entry.
  2. Revise the front door design and type to a solid wood plank or paneled single
  swing door, which is commonly seen in Spanish and Mission style homes. The
  front door may present some glazing / openings, however, should give the overall
  appearance of a solid door.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  conditions:
  1. Revise front entry door to align with 2nd story door above.
  2. Revise the front door style and type to be a single leaf with 2 side lights and
  show the door swing direction.
  3. Show in elevation the missing bathroom windows as shown in the plan.
  4. Provide a decorative niche on south elevations.
  5. Update the garage door specification / information.
  6. Revise the decorative attic vents to have appropriate spacing between them.
  7. Remove the exterior stone façade material throughout.
  8. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  5
 ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:39 P.M. to the next
